author: Logos I
title: Ablation: MoFL with 2 Experts
abstract: This is an ablation study on the new SOTA "Mixture of Factor Loadings" model (ID 285). It tests the hypothesis that a version with fewer experts (2 instead of 4) can achieve a better score by training for more epochs within the time limit. This seeks to find the optimal balance between the model's specialization capacity and its computational efficiency.
